entries.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: illustrative accessory photograph for a scooter dealer website, Protezione personale. Create one realistic studio still-life photograph of a generic matte charcoal motorcycle helmet in three-quarter view with its clear visor closed, and one pair of black protective riding gloves arranged naturally in front. No brand, no logos, no writing, no certification marks, no recognizable commercial model. Warm light grey seamless background and matte tabletop, soft daylight from upper left, restrained neutral tones, clear material texture, no bokeh effects or decorative props. Portrait 4:5 composition, entire helmet and gloves clearly within the central 80% of the image, compact grouping legible at 300px width; leave enough vertical margin to also allow a central 4:3 crop. Photographic illustration only, no implied stock availability or actual location. Single image, no collage, no border, no text.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: illustrative workshop detail photograph for a scooter dealer website, Montaggio accessori. Create one realistic close-up photograph of two gloved human hands installing a generic black smartphone holder on a plain scooter handlebar. One hand steadies the empty four-corner phone cradle, the other holds a simple L-shaped hex key with its short end seated in one visible clamp bolt. Mechanically plausible clamp fixed around a horizontal round handlebar tube, rubber grips on the cradle visible, modest handlebar control housing at frame edge. Exactly two anatomically plausible hands. Frame tightly around hands, cradle, clamp and tool, no face, no room overview, no business premises identification. Landscape 4:3 composition, important action in central 75% width and 70% height, also suitable for a central 3:2 crop. Soft neutral daylight from upper left, charcoal/grey materials, sober out-of-focus grey workbench background without signage or decorative bokeh, natural texture. No logos, no brand names, no text, no invented commercial model, no actual location or staff claims. Photographic illustration, single image, no collage, no border.
